feeds.title: Handmade by Carolyn
feeds.description: Carolyn shares thoughts on sewing, knitting, and looking her best. She lives in Perth, Western Australia, and makes her own clothes.

feeds.title: Subversive Femme Blog
feeds.description: A blog devoted to vintage knitting, sewing and the vintage lifestyle. Inspiration for those who are just dipping in their toe, and connecting with those who live their passion everyday.

feeds.title: Say! Little Hen Blog
feeds.description: An Australian blog aiming to inspire you creatively, share the joys of knitting and help you bake delicious wholefoods & spelt sourdough. Little Hen is passionate about organic, sustainable and ethical yarns, with a focus on high-quality yarns that are delightful to knit and crochet with.

feeds.title: Sonia Knits
feeds.description: I'm a knitter and a spinner living in Melbourne, Australia. I love acquiring stash and occasionally I even use it. I knit for myself, my husband and the babies in my life. I have made great friends through this passion of mine. Blog by Sonia.

feeds.title: little woollie
feeds.description: I have a love for crafty things, crochet, knitting and yarny makes, in particular, so you will be seeing a lot of my crafty adventures on this blog! A local wool shop filled with quality natural fibers and colorful yarns including wool, alpaca, cotton, and bamboo, with a mix of gorgeous brands and indie dyers. Blog by Julie Harrison.

feeds.title: Jorth Knits
feeds.description: Modern knitting patterns produced in Melbourne, Australia by Leisl.

feeds.title: What Jane Knits Blog
feeds.description: The blog I have created is to help beginner and novice knitters create nice things! I love knitting simple yet stylish accessories and garments and I find it so rewarding for these pieces to become part of my everyday wardrobe.

feeds.title: Knit Crochet Stitch Play
feeds.description: I am a fibre artist based in Melbourne Australia, who loves to dabble in freeform knitting/crochet and all things fibre. My work springs from a lifelong passion with colour and texture. My work is a combination of traditional knitting, freeform knitting, machine knitting and hand and machine felting.

feeds.title: Brunswick Machine Knitting Novices
feeds.description: We are a club of the Machine Knitters Association of Victoria with a mission to give novices a chance to try out the craft of machine knitting without needing to own a knitting machine.We like simple techniques and interesting fibres and design.We embrace both retro and contemporary style in knitted textiles.

feeds.title: Grandma's Knitting Place
feeds.description: This is my place to show off my knitting, crochet or whatever! My cats, dogs, grandkids, sunsets, cooking. Maybe a few thoughts on various subjects. I love to read your comments- but please leave an email address or something so that I can reply won't you?

feeds.title: Ruby Girl
feeds.description: A bit of this and a bit of that.....knitting included. I love to knit, spend time with my family and friends, gardening and reading when time permits.

feeds.title: Baroque Purls Blog
feeds.description: I'm a knitting pattern designer, singer, and early music geek. This blog is where I let my obsessions out to play. My goal is to help you make the most of your beautiful yarn, and help make your projects the best they can be by providing simple clear instructions and helpful tips.

feeds.title: Knitting-and.com Blog
feeds.description: Free knitting patterns, crochet, tatting, teneriffe lace, looming, weaving and hairpin lace, craft projects, writing, ghost stories and recipes.

feeds.title: aussie knitting threads
feeds.description: Aussie knitting threads and other creative activities by she who knit. Blog by Marion Starr.by she who knits

feeds.title: Mooroolbark Wool-The Aussie Knitting Co Blog
feeds.description: In this blog we'll discuss the best time saving tips for knitters. Although it's a long read this will help you save countless hours through the years. Both beginners and experienced hobbyists will benefit from the tips we're about to discuss.

feeds.title: Knitterbox
feeds.description: Discover everything you need to master knitting & crocheting. Get inspired by free knitting and crochet patterns, learn from how-to guides & top knitters.

feeds.title: MelsNattyKnits
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Melanie and I love knitting, spinning, weaving, crocheting, constantly increasing my stash, reading, cryptic crosswords, playing scrabble with my dear friends and eating chocolate.
